content: The wireless network signal is too weak. 1. Position your wireless router, modem router, or access point in a central location. Avoid putting it in a corner. 2. Use a wireless repeater to get an instant boost in your wireless signal strength. Place the repeater halfway between your wireless router and your TV. 3. The most common wireless technology, 802.11g (wireless-G), operates at a frequency of 2.4 GHz. This frequency is widely used by many cordless phones, microwave ovens, baby monitors, garage doors, and other wireless devices. Reduce interference by not using or turning off wireless devices that use the 2.4 GHz frequency. Instead, use devices that communicate via the 5.0 GHz frequency.
